# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, modern environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies for building Laghos and its dependencies (MFEM, MPI)
# Includes build tools, compilers, Git, MPI libraries, and other required scientific libraries.
# Also includes OpenSSH for MPI communication across nodes and ca-certificates for network access.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    make \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    openssh-client \
    openssh-server \
    libmetis-dev \
    liblapack-dev \
    libblas-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure passwordless SSH for root user, a common requirement for MPI runners like mpirun.
# This allows the MPI master process to SSH into other containers (pods) to start worker processes.
RUN mkdir -p /root/.ssh && \
    ssh-keygen -t rsa -f /root/.ssh/id_rsa -N '' && \
    cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && \
    chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && \
    # Configure sshd to allow root login and disable password authentication
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/#PasswordAuthentication yes/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    # Add host keys for sshd
    ssh-keygen -A

# Set the working directory for the build process
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Clone the latest versions of MFEM and Laghos from their repositories
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git

# Build the parallel version of MFEM with MPI and Metis support
RUN cd mfem && \
    make config MFEM_USE_MPI=yes MFEM_USE_METIS_5=yes && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc)

# Build the parallel version of Laghos (p-laghos)
# The MFEM_DIR variable is explicitly set to point to the sibling mfem directory.
RUN cd Laghos && \
    make p-laghos -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=../mfem

# Copy the compiled Laghos parallel executable to a system path for easy access
# Renaming to 'laghos' for convenience.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/p-laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos

# Create a final application directory and copy the Laghos data files into it
RUN mkdir -p /app && cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Set the final working directory to where the application data is located
WORKDIR /app

# Set a default command to start a shell, allowing for interactive use or easy command overrides
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Also includes OpenSSH for MPI communication across nodes and ca-certificates for network access.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    g++ \
    gfortran \
    make \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    openssh-client \
    openssh-server \
    libmetis-dev \
    libhypre-dev \
    liblapack-dev \
    libblas-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure passwordless SSH for root user, a common requirement for MPI runners like mpirun.
# This allows the MPI master process to SSH into other containers (pods) to start worker processes.
RUN mkdir -p /root/.ssh && \
    ssh-keygen -t rsa -f /root/.ssh/id_rsa -N '' && \
    cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && \
    chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && \
    # Configure sshd to allow root login and disable password authentication
    sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    sed -i 's/#PasswordAuthentication yes/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && \
    # Add host keys for sshd
    ssh-keygen -A

# Set the working directory for the build process
WORKDIR /opt/build

# Clone the latest versions of MFEM and Laghos from their repositories
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git

# Build the parallel version of MFEM with MPI, Metis, and HYPRE support.
# CORRECTED: Changed HYPRE_INCLUDE to point to the correct system include directory /usr/include/hypre
RUN cd mfem && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) \
    CXX=mpicxx \
    MFEM_USE_MPI=yes \
    MFEM_USE_METIS_5=yes \
    MFEM_USE_HYPRE=yes \
    HYPRE_INCLUDE="-I/usr/include/hypre" \
    HYPRE_LIBS="-lHYPRE"

# Build the parallel version of Laghos (p-laghos)
# The MFEM_DIR variable is explicitly set to point to the sibling mfem directory.
RUN cd Laghos && \
    make p-laghos -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=../mfem

# Copy the compiled Laghos parallel executable to a system path for easy access
# Renaming to 'laghos' for convenience.
RUN cp /opt/build/Laghos/p-laghos /usr/local/bin/laghos

# Create a final application directory and copy the Laghos data files into it
RUN mkdir -p /app && cp /opt/build/Laghos/data/* /app/

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/build

# Set the final working directory to where the application data is located
WORKDIR /app

# Set a default command to start a shell, allowing for interactive use or easy command overrides
CMD ["/bin/bash"]
